subject: Tamil (second language)

source.read: CISCE curriculum for Classes I-VIII (primary and upper primary)
source.note: CISCE lists Tamil as a permitted second language but publishes class-wise outcomes only for Hindi. These outcomes follow the same skill themes (listening and speaking, reading, writing, vocabulary, grammar, literature), written by OpenPath for Tamil.

licence: Outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.

outcomes.text: Takes part in a discussion and asks questions.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who listens. The app does not hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Identifies case endings and the eight cases.
Reads a history passage and answers questions.
Writes a short essay and a letter to a relative.
Studies the lessons and poems of the school's textbook.
outcomes.note: The school's own textbook is not reproduced (it is copyrighted). OpenPath's own stories and poems practise the same questions on character, theme, meaning and poetic devices.

outcomes.text: Reads a story and talks about its characters, events and message.
